title: Chapter 581 - 581 Kill!!!
content:
Chapter 581 - 581 Kill!!!

Chapter 581 - 581 Kill!!!

581 Kill!!!

Originally, many people had faith in Lin Fan. They thought that he was the hope of Hua Nation and that he was an omnipotent god.

However, when everyone saw the blog post posted by Ai Jin, they were shocked.

They started to lose confidence and started to doubt Lin Fan.

Many people joined the comments on Ai Jin’s blog, and fear and panic grew in their hearts.

Ai Jin did not care about the change in the mentality of ordinary people.

He looked at the increasing number of readers and fans, his face was full of smiles.

It was all money!

…

Lin Fan did not know what was happening on Earth.

At this moment, he had already gone past the hill. After walking forward for a while, a wide and clear lake gradually appeared in the distance.

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Quiker: [It’s the lake that Hendry encountered!]

Water: [It’s over, it’s over!]

Selling Kidney: [I hope God Lin doesn’t go into the water. Yes, God Lin definitely won’t go into the water. His clothes and face need to be kept very clean.]

Men Also Need to Be Hurt: [With God Lin’s strength, it’s not a problem even if he goes into the water.]

World: [Didn’t you see Ai Jin’s analysis?]

Fool: [Although I hate Ai Jin, his analysis does make some sense. Sigh, I only hope that God Lin doesn’t go near the lake.]

Steamed or Braised: [That lake is so terrifying. It’s like an abyss. God Lin will sense the danger and won’t go over.]

…

However…

Things often went against one’s wishes.

Lin Fan felt as though his soul had been seduced by the lake as he continued walking forward at a steady pace.

Ten meters.

Nine meters.

Eight meters.

…

Soon, he arrived at the lake.

Lin Fan looked at the reflection on the calm lake. Then, he raised his head and looked at the other side of the lake.

At this moment, a monster that looked like a crocodile but was ten meters long suddenly jumped out of the water.

It was the crocodile monster that had eaten Hendry.

An extremely terrifying and ferocious aura surged over like a tide.

At that moment, the entire world seemed to darken, and the air froze.

Lin Fan seemed to be completely shocked. He stood on the spot and did not move.

…

This scene was shown on Hua Nation’s live broadcast.

“Professor Lin, run! It’s dangerous!” Xiao Bing shouted anxiously.”

Countless bullet comments instantly filled the entire live broadcast room.

World Ghost: [God Lin, don’t just stand there! Run!]

Galaxy: [The monster that killed Hendry!]

The Nine Heavens Primordial Essence: [It’s so terrifying.]

Half Body: [Run!]

Fly With the Dream: [Run!]

Suiyuan: [Run!]

…

The dense bullet comments telling Lin Fan to run seemed to have turned into a storm, completely covering the entire livestream room.

…

The hearts of Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Hu Tian, Qin Yuxuan, and the others instantly rose to their throats.

They were extremely worried.

The crocodile monster was too big and looked so terrifying.

‘Please don’t let anything happen to Lin Fan.’

…

Lin Fan got closer and closer to the lake, his eyes lighting up.

When the crocodile monster jumped out of the water and appeared in front of Lin Fan, his face was filled with excitement.

Ai Jin’s eyes moved as his hands jumped quickly on the keyboard. He posted another blog post.

Ai Jin: [It’s not that Professor Lin doesn’t want to run, but he’s too scared to move. This is the instinctive reaction of weak creatures to powerful creatures.]

…

At this moment, the crocodile monster opened its huge mouth and gave off a terrifying aura as it bit at Lin Fan.

Everyone had no doubt that Lin Fan would be turned into a puddle of blood just like Hendry in the next second.

Some people even closed their eyes in fear.

However…

When the crocodile monster’s mouth was only a meter away from Lin Fan, everyone was stunned.

Lin Fan moved!

Lin Fan did not even lift his eyelids. He used his thumb to push the Star Meteorite Sword in his hand.

[Skill: One of the swords, sword slash!]

A bright light flashed.

The crocodile monster’s body suddenly stopped.

In the next moment, its head was split into two like a watermelon.

In the end, it fell to the ground with a dull thud.

Bright red blood spurted out like a fountain!

The entire scene suddenly fell silent!
